podcast.title: Variant Cancer and Death
podcast.body: Mimi Parker, the singer and drummer for the beloved indie band Low, died of a variant cancer on November 5, 2022, at the age of 55. Her passing marked a significant loss for the indie music community. "She died of a variant cancer on November 5, 2022 at the age of 55."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
